title: General Meetings
text: The ultimate authority of a registered society shall vest in the general body of its members. A general meeting shall be convened at least once in a year for the purpose of approval of the budget, consideration of the audit report, and disposal of net profits.

title: Elections
text: The election of the members of the board shall be conducted by the Cooperative Election Commission. The term of office of the board shall be five years from the date of election. No person shall be eligible to be elected as a member of the board if he is in default to the society.

title: Audit
text: The accounts of every registered society shall be audited at least once in every year by the Director of Cooperative Audit or any person authorized by him. The audit shall include an examination of overdue debts, if any, and a valuation of the assets and liabilities of the society.

title: Expulsion of Members
text: A registered society may, by a resolution passed by a two-thirds majority of the members present and voting at a general meeting, expel a member for acts which are detrimental to the proper working of the society, provided the member has been given a reasonable opportunity of being heard.

title: Winding-up
text: If the Registrar, after an inquiry has been held or an inspection has been made, or on receipt of an application made by not less than three-fourths of the members of a registered society, is of opinion that the society ought to be wound up, he may issue an order directing it to be wound up.
